question: A triangle has angles 60°, 60°, and 60°. It is a/an ___.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

All angles = 60°

⇒ All angles equal ⇒ All sides equal

⇒ Triangle is Equilateral

**∴ Answer = Equilateral Triangle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Angles of triangle = 60°, 60°, 60°

**Property:**

If all angles of a triangle are equal, then all sides are equal

 
 60° 60° 60° 

**Conclusion:**

⇒ All sides equal

⇒ Triangle is Equilateral

**∴ Type of triangle = Equilateral Triangle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Equilateral Triangle:** All sides equal, each angle = 60°

**Isosceles Triangle:** Two sides equal, two angles equal

**Scalene Triangle:** All sides and angles different

**Angle Sum Property:** Sum of angles in triangle = 180°
